result.summary: Prepares the release branch for the final Bitcoin Core v32.0 release. It updates CMake configuration to set CLIENT_VERSION_IS_RELEASE to true and bump the minor version to 0, regenerates manual pages, and reintegrates the final release notes.
result.problem: The 32.0 branch remains configured as a pre-release build (32.99 / non-release) with incomplete manual pages and release notes, preventing the distribution of official release binaries and documentation.
evidence: Commit 4995293a73 ('build: bump version to v32.0') sets CLIENT_VERSION_MINOR to 0 and CLIENT_VERSION_IS_RELEASE to true in CMakeLists.txt
Commit 42d0ac57e5 ('doc: reintegrate release notes') replaces the empty release note template with the accumulated v32.0 release notes
PR description specifies release wrap-up tracking: 'TODO: rc4? Any further release notes.'
result.scope_notes: The commit history contains three standard release-process commits (version bump, man page updates, and release notes reintegration), though git diff against the branch base captures intermediate branch merges.
result.changed_since_previous: None. The commit set and release finalization approach remain identical to the previous version.
result.card: Finalizes the Bitcoin Core v32.0 release branch for the general release. It sets the client version to 32.0 release in the build system, regenerates the manual pages, and reintegrates the complete v32.0 release notes. Without these changes, official release binaries and documentation cannot be tagged and distributed. This is a standard release maintenance step for the v32.0 milestone.

risk.why: Mistakes in the release build configuration could result in mislabeled binaries or release artifacts being published.
